title: Lines and Inequalities
subject: algebra
instructions: Show your steps. Write your ID number, not your name.

questions.key: Distributes to 3x − 12 = 2x + 5, collects x terms (x − 12 = 5), and adds 12 to get x = 17. A correct check by substitution also earns the work point.

questions.prompt: Solve and write the answer as an inequality:  −2x + 7 ≤ 15
questions.key: Subtracts 7 (−2x ≤ 8), then divides by −2 and flips the inequality sign to get x ≥ −4. Not flipping the sign is the key mistake to name.

questions.prompt: Graph y = 2x − 1 on the grid. Mark at least two points you used.

diagram.description: A coordinate grid from −5 to 5 on both axes, grid lines every 1, labels every 1.

checklist.item: The line crosses the y-axis at (0, −1).
The line rises 2 for every 1 to the right (passes through points like (1, 1) and (2, 3)).
At least two points are marked on the line.

questions.prompt: Complete the table for y = x² − 3.

options.why: Square roots don't add that way: find each root first.
That adds 49 and 9, then halves. Take each root first.
